sv.title: Barn dödades i attacken mot Zelenskyjs hemstad
sv.summary: Under fredagskvällen – på internationella barndagen – bombade Ryssland Zelenskyjs hemstad och en sjuårig pojke rapporteras ha dödats när han var ute och lekte, rapporterar Kiev Independent. När ambulansvårdare kom bombades även dem.

en.title: Child killed in attack on Zelenskyy's hometown
en.summary: On Friday evening – on International Children's Day – Russia bombed Zelenskyy's hometown and a seven-year-old boy is reported to have been killed while playing outside, according to the Kyiv Independent. Paramedics were also bombed when they arrived.
